description: TOTP enrollment, challenge, and recovery codes are ported and hardened, with per-realm enforcement policy.

requirements.description: Users must be able to enroll TOTP-based MFA (RFC 6238), generating a QR-encodable provisioning URI and a set of single-use recovery codes. After enrollment, sign-in requires a TOTP challenge step before a session is established. Recovery codes bypass TOTP but are single-use and audited. Realms can enforce MFA as mandatory (sign-in fails without enrolled MFA). TOTP shared secrets and recovery code hashes are stored encrypted at rest.
requirements.title: TOTP MFA Enrollment, Challenge, and Recovery Codes with Per-Realm Enforcement

validation.notes: api/internal/mfa/totp_test.go: generate TOTP secret, compute TOTP code for current time window, verify it passes; verify code from previous window is accepted within clock-skew tolerance; verify code from two windows ago is rejected

api/internal/mfa/totp_test.go: recovery codes are generated as cryptographically random strings, hashed before storage; presenting the plaintext code verifies against the hash; each code is marked used after first use and rejected on replay
api/internal/mfa/totp_test.go: per-realm MFA enforcement: when realm requires MFA, sign-in without enrolled MFA returns MFA-required error
api/handlers/mfa/totp_e2e_test.go: enroll TOTP for a user → provisioning URI returned; sign in → password accepted → TOTP challenge issued → submit valid code → session and tokens issued
api/handlers/mfa/totp_e2e_test.go: submit invalid TOTP code → challenge fails; submit a recovery code → session issued; replay same recovery code → rejected
api/handlers/mfa/totp_e2e_test.go: MFA enrollment and removal are written to audit log

bas/mfa/totp_enrollment_test: user opens self-service MFA page, scans QR code with authenticator app, enters TOTP code to confirm enrollment, then signs out and signs back in completing the TOTP challenge

title: TOTP MFA + Recovery Codes
